correctness.rationale: The four Markov partition cells have lengths 1/3,1/6,1/6,1/3, and restricted rise-state transition Q=[[1/3,1/6],[0,1/3]], whose nontrivial Jordan block gives R_n=(n+2)/(2*3^n). The next-rise conditional ratio (n+3)/(3(n+2)) strictly changes with n, impossible for any finite Markov order. The calibrated binary surrogate has plus-stay 4/9, stationary plus probability 1/2, so its run likelihood (1/2)(4/9)^(n-1) divided by actual R_n tends exponentially to infinity. This is only a statement about the observable binary factor, not the four-state hidden chain.
